steps.en: The vehicle number is checked against the active classified list
steps.id: Nomor kendaraan dicek terhadap daftar classified yang aktif

steps.en: The offence date must fall within the record's date range
steps.id: Tanggal pelanggaran harus ada dalam rentang tanggal record
steps.why_en: Only the vehicle number and status are checked; there are no dates to compare.
steps.why_id: Hanya nomor kendaraan dan status yang dicek; tidak ada tanggal untuk dibandingkan.

steps.en: Classified notices are marked and handled accordingly
steps.id: Notice classified ditandai dan diproses sesuai tandanya

steps.en: Earlier notices are picked up when the list changes
steps.id: Notice lama ikut teridentifikasi saat daftar berubah
steps.why_en: Identification happens only when a notice is created; older notices are never rechecked.
steps.why_id: Identifikasi hanya terjadi saat notice dibuat; notice lama tidak dicek ulang.
